LED strip theme

Source: R/theme_ledstrip.R
theme_ledstrip.Rd

LED strip lights are the adhesive color changing lights that line bedroom ceilings and desks. LED strips are often called TikTok lights. Refinery29 tracked the trend on TikTok from 2020 onward and called it Gen Z's answer to the fairy lights of the 2010s. For teens in bare bedrooms or dorms, a cheap strip of lights is one of the few ways to make a space their own. Recent coverage notes Gen Z lighting turning softer and dimmer.

Usage

theme_ledstrip(
  base_size = 15,
  base_family = register_font("Arial", "Arial.ttf", "Arial Bold.ttf"),
  title_family = register_font("Silom", "Silom.ttf"),
  mode = c("dark", "light")
)

Arguments

base_size

Base font size. Defaults to 15.

base_family

Base font family. Defaults to Arial when it's available on the system, otherwise "sans".

title_family

Title font family. Defaults to Silom when it's available, otherwise "sans".

mode

"dark" (the default) or "light".

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

Details

The palette follows TikTok lights along a dark bedroom wall: hot pink, electric blue, purple, red, cyan, and green.

Use mode = "light" for a light background with dark text and darker marks.

See also

LED strip light on Wikipedia.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data.frame(x = c("a", "b", "b")), aes(x = x, fill = x)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "LED strip") +
  theme_ledstrip(base_family = "sans", title_family = "sans")
